notes.title: DEMO update
notes.notes:
Greetings, orc warriors! We extend our heartfelt thanks for participating in the festival demo of Orc Warchief: Strategy City Builder. Your engagement, bug reports, and valuable feedback truly propel us forward as we strive for excellence in crafting this epic city-building strategy.

And now, the latest news regarding update 0.103! After listening to your feedback, we've made several significant changes that we hope will make your experiences even more epic:


 We've improved gameplay balance to provide more satisfying strategic experiences.
 We've increased the amount of available wood to facilitate the construction and development of your settlement.
 We've made adjustments to the consumption of leather and beer, impacting the game's economy.
 We've fixed an menu bug.
 We've implemented map navigation improvements to make movement and world exploration easier.
 We've resolved issues with structure collision to make building smoother and more efficient.

We hope these changes will make your experience in the world of Orc Warchief even more satisfying. We eagerly await further feedback and suggestions from your end! Keep playing and reign as a true orc warlord!

notes.title: Small Update #4
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Let's play one more quiz about the Orc Warchief game.
Here are some facts about our orcs. Some of them are true, but 4 are false. Try guess which ones are false:
1.    Some orcs are luckier than others.
2.    There are just as many high-ranking female orcs as male ones. 
3.    All orcs dream of being a Warchief one day.
4.    Warchief’s position cannot be disputed by anyone. 
5.    Orcs can learn to wield more than 12 different types of weapons.
6.    Orcs working with friends are more productive.
7.    Warchief is advised by several lieutenants. 
8.    Orcs mainly use timber, and animal hides in construction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/7ab6ef672185ed1e3ef3bd02e4b9a3536584d3c6.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/d0779645eeb227302cc12e5dcf0fb4f627569dae.jpg

9.    Warchief maintains the loyalty of the members of the tribe through threats of violence.
10.    Many interpersonal disputes orcs solve through single combat. 
11.    Orc War Parties live and train together.
12.    Staying away from a fight for too long lowers the War Party’s morale.
13.    Orcs value honor and bravery above other virtues.
14.    Orcs are inherently cruel and violent.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442426/a6322a960d03a002b5be4d07da8b6bdae711bbf3.jpg

15.    Warchief inherits the title from their parents/relatives. 
16.    Orcs respect the dead and believe in honorable death. 

Leave your assumptions in the comments.
See you soon.
Best regards,
Dev Tribe
